create_candidate: create a Candidate dataclass instance with a name and probability for an attribute value
build_attribute: build an Attribute dataclass with a name, list of Candidate values, and importance score
create_relation: create a Relation dataclass describing spatial orientation between two entities
build_entity: build an Entity dataclass with name, importance score, attributes, and entity type
create_belief_state: create a BeliefState scene graph from lists of Entity and Relation objects
